title: Early Signals, Strong Decisions: Prefix-Guided Sampling for Parallel Test-Time Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2611.14965v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parallel test-time scaling (TTS) has been shown to enhance reasoning in large language models by generating and aggregating multiple independent reasoning paths. Internal confidence scores can further improve this process by identifying paths of varying quality. However, existing methods remain computationally inefficient, as low-quality paths are fully expanded before being evaluated. In this work, we aim to improve the use of internal confidence signals for better model performance and computational efficiency. We begin by offering a new perspective on the role of confidence in aggregation, showing that it is most impactful for questions near the decision boundary. Notably, when amplified by multi-sample aggregation, even small confidence signals derived from short prefixes can meaningfully influence outcomes in these boundary cases. translated_title: 早期信号，强决策：面向并行测试时扩展的前缀引导采样
translated_abstract: 并行测试时扩展已被证明能够通过生成并聚合多条独立推理路径来增强大语言模型的推理能力。内部置信度分数可以通过识别不同质量的路径来进一步改进这一过程。然而，现有方法在计算上仍然效率低下，因为低质量路径在被评估之前会被完全展开。在这项工作中，我们旨在更好地利用内部置信度信号，以提升模型性能和计算效率。我们首先对置信度在聚合中的作用提出了一个新的视角，表明置信度对于接近决策边界的问题最具影响力。值得注意的是，当通过多样本聚合进行放大时，即使是从短前缀中提取的微小置信度信号，也能在这些边界情形中有意义地影响结果。基于这一见解，我们提出了前缀引导采样，该方法重新分配计算资源……
tldr: 该论文提出前缀引导采样方法，利用短前缀产生的早期置信度信号在推理初始阶段就识别并提前终止低质量推理路径，从而在提升大语言模型推理性能的同时显著提高并行测试时扩展的计算效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Prefix-Guided Sampling, which leverages early confidence signals from short prefixes to identify and prune low-quality reasoning paths at the start, improving both reasoning performance and computational efficiency in parallel test-time scaling.
